info.title: open-taskboard API
info.description: Local-first task board REST API (Fastify + node:sqlite). Remote/non-loopback binds require one-time administrator setup and browser login using an HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict session cookie. TASKBOARD_TOKEN remains an optional compatibility credential for machine clients; browser users never need to paste a token. Loopback-only development can run without login. When TASKBOARD_READONLY=1, every mutating request (POST/PATCH/DELETE) is rejected with 403 before the handler runs. Writes may record the acting agent via the x-taskboard-actor header. PATCH /api/issues/{id} uses optimistic locking via version.

get.summary: List sessions from an OpenCode v1 server (create-project flow)
get.description: Stateless variant used before a project exists. `url` is optional: when blank the server resolves a default in this order — `TASKBOARD_OPENCODE_URL` → the newest project wakeChannel → `http://127.0.0.1:4096`. An explicit `url` wins and must be an http(s) origin. When `workspacePath` is provided, only sessions with the same directory are returned.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: OpenCode server origin, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:4096; blank → default resolution order

parameters.name: workspacePath
parameters.description: Only return sessions whose directory matches this workspace

/api/projects/{projectId}/git-refs.summary: Branches + worktrees of the project workspace

get.summary: Git branches and worktrees
get.description: Scans the project workspacePath with git. Any git failure (no workspace, not a repo, git missing, timeout) collapses to empty arrays — this endpoint never 500s for git reasons.

/api/projects/{projectId}/commits.summary: Recent commits of the project workspace

get.summary: Recent commits (newest first, max 5)
get.description: If `ref` matches a worktree NAME, commits come from that worktree checkout at HEAD; anything else is treated as a git ref inside workspacePath. Empty/unset ref or no workspace → `{ "commits": [] }`. Git failures → empty list.

parameters.name: ref
parameters.description: Branch name, worktree name, or any git ref

get.description: Stats feature landing in parallel — behavior as implemented: `weeks` falls back to 8 when missing/non-numeric; the store clamps the final range to 1..26 weeks (0/−3 → 1, 99 → 26).

parameters.name: weeks
parameters.description: Window length in weeks (clamped to 1..26; default 8)

/api/projects/{projectId}/issues.summary: List / create issues under a project

get.summary: List issues with filters
get.description: Archived rows are excluded by default. `archived=only` returns just archived rows; `archived=all` returns everything. `parentId=null` (literal string) selects top-level issues only. `includeDone=false` drops done rows. Order: priority (urgent→low), then creation.

parameters.name: parentId
parameters.description: Exact parent issue id; the literal string "null" means top-level only

post.description: projectId comes from the path, never the body. Parent rules: max two levels (parent must be top-level, same project) — violations → 400; unknown parent/project → 404.

get.summary: Issue detail (children, comments, activities, dependencies)

patch.summary: Patch an issue (optimistic lock via optional version)
patch.description: Send the `version` from your last read to guard against concurrent overwrites — a mismatch → 409. For every actual status change by an agent, include `statusNote` with reason, verification evidence and unchecked items; status and comment are committed atomically. Web actions may omit the note and receive an explicit automatic audit comment.

post.summary: Archive (sets archivedAt; hides from default lists)
Take or renew the exclusive lease
post.description: T7-34: re-entrant for the same agent (a second claim renews). Another agent's ACTIVE lease → 409; an expired lease is fair game. Row mutation: bumps version + updated_at and logs a claimed activity.

/api/issues/{id}/heartbeat.summary: Renew the lease of an issue you hold

post.description: T7-34: extends lease_expires_at by ttlMinutes (default 30). Pure lease op — no version bump, no updated_at touch, no activity; still emits issue.updated. Non-holder or expired lease → 409.

200.description: The issue with the renewed lease

/api/issues/{id}/release.summary: Release the lease of an issue

post.description: T7-34: clearing an ACTIVE claim bumps version + updated_at and logs a released activity; releasing an unclaimed or expired issue is an idempotent no-op (200, no side effects). Another holder's ACTIVE claim → 409. ttlMinutes in the body is tolerated and ignored.

get.summary: Comments, oldest first

delete.summary: Delete a comment (FTS index cleaned, activity logged)

post.description: Same project only; self-dependency and cycles → 400; unknown issue ids → 404; duplicate edge → 409 (reserved).

delete.description: Unknown issue ids → 404; a non-existent edge → 400.

/api/issues/{id}/attachments.summary: List / upload attachments of an issue

get.summary: Attachment metadata rows, oldest first
get.description: GET /api/issues/{id} (IssueDetail) carries the same array under `attachments`.

post.description: Exactly one `file` part; empty files and blank filenames → 400; over-limit bodies → 413. The metadata row is stored in sqlite, the body on disk under <dataDir>/attachments/<issueId>/. Read-only mode (TASKBOARD_READONLY=1) rejects the POST with 403 before the handler runs.

file.description: The attachment body (filename becomes the record name)

get.summary: Stream the file as application/octet-stream
get.description: RFC 5987 content-disposition (`filename*=UTF-8''…`) preserves non-ASCII names. Unknown row or missing on-disk file → 404.

post.summary: Write a VACUUM INTO snapshot under <dataDir>/backups/
post.description: Manual on-demand snapshot — ignores TASKBOARD_BACKUPS=0 (an explicit request always backs up). TASKBOARD_READONLY=1 still rejects it: a snapshot is a disk write.

get.summary: Search issue titles, descriptions and comment bodies
get.description: Trigram FTS for queries ≥3 chars (a comment hit maps to its parent issue); shorter queries fall back to a case-insensitive LIKE scan over title/description. Archived issues are excluded.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search phrase (min 1 char after trim; missing/blank → 400)

get.summary: The OpenAPI 3.1 document describing this API

/api/issues/{id}/create-worktree.summary: Create and bind an isolated Git worktree for a task

post.description: Creates a dedicated branch and worktree for the task. Rejects conflicts and active task leases. Clears any prior Session binding because a Session rooted in the project's main checkout must not be reused from the new worktree; create a new Session in the bound worktree.

400.description: Project workspace missing or is not a Git repository

409.description: Branch/path collision or task already has a Git binding

500.description: Worktree created but binding persistence failed; response includes the path for recovery

502.description: Git failed to create the worktree

post.description: Used by the watch process to persist dispatch, retry, success, and failure events. For bound OpenCode sessions, running/idle are observational session-level states. The watcher correlates a unique marker in the injected user message with a subsequent Assistant reply; only a correlated reply followed by Session idle is reported as succeeded. Idle by itself is never proof of task completion.

/api/issues/{id}/git-binding.summary: Release task Git binding without deleting local resources

delete.description: Clears the task's branch, worktree name and absolute path. Does not delete local Git branches or worktree directories. Rejected while the task has an active claim lease.

409.description: Task has an active execution lease

sessionId.description: Compatibility alias for defaultSessionId; empty string clears it

sessionId.description: opencode session to bind at creation. Precedence: explicit sessionId → x-taskboard-session header → project default session → null (unbound).

confirm.description: T7-36 escape hatch: with TASKBOARD_HUMAN_DONE=1, an agent may create an issue directly at done after the user confirmed in conversation

worktreePath.description: Absolute path of the bound git worktree; null clears the binding

UpdateIssueRequest.description: PATCH /api/issues/{id} body — all fields optional, version optional on REST (strict); every actual non-web status transition must include statusNote; the status update and audit comment are committed atomically. Web status changes without a note receive an automatic labelled audit comment.

confirm.description: T7-36 escape hatch: with TASKBOARD_HUMAN_DONE=1, an agent may set done after the user confirmed in conversation

statusNote.description: Required for an actual agent status transition. Explain reason, verification evidence, and unchecked items; saved as a comment in the same transaction as the status update.

worktreePath.description: Absolute path of the bound git worktree; null clears the binding

ClaimRequest.description: POST /api/issues/{id}/claim|heartbeat|release body (strict). ttlMinutes: lease duration on claim (default 30, max 1440), a fresh duration on heartbeat, tolerated-and-ignored on release. sessionId (claim only): binds the claimer's opencode session when the issue is unbound; an existing binding is never overwritten (tolerated-and-ignored on heartbeat/release).

BackupCreated.description: POST /api/backup response — path of the freshly written snapshot

Attachment.description: Attachment metadata row — the body lives on disk, never in this payload

id.description: Generated 8-char id (used by the download route)

BadRequest.description: Validation error (bad enum/filter value, malformed body, unknown strict-schema key, impossible parent/dependency)

Unauthorized.description: TASKBOARD_TOKEN is set and no valid Bearer header / ?token= was presented

Forbidden.description: Read-only mode (TASKBOARD_READONLY=1) rejects mutating requests; reserved for done-requires-confirmation

NotFound.description: Resource (project / issue / parent / dependency target) not found

Conflict.description: Optimistic-lock version mismatch, duplicate project id, or duplicate dependency edge (reserved for claim conflicts)
